blocks.en: Appendix H Human Perception Analysis
blocks.zh: 附录H 人类认知分析

blocks.en:
We randomly sample 100 source images, equally distributed in four datasets.
Each source image is paired with its GeoCloak , GeoShield, and M-Attack output, producing 300 rating tasks.
Two independent annotators evaluate the same trials.
In each trial, the original image is presented alongside one protected image.
The defense identities are hidden.
Annotators score each protected image on a five-point Likert scale for naturalness, semantic preservation relative to the original image, and overall quality, with overall quality designated as the primary metric.
The evaluation interface provides the following guidelines as follows: • naturalness assesses whether the protected image appears natural and realistic without obvious artifacts. • semantic preservation assesses whether the main objects, scene, and meaning of the original image are retained. • overall quality assesses the protected image holistically by considering both naturalness and content preservation. All three metrics use the same five-point scale, ranging from 1 (severe and unacceptable problems) to 5 (a natural, complete image with almost no visible problems).
blocks.zh:
我们随机抽取100张源图像,同样分布在四个数据集.
每个源图像都与其GeoCloak,GeoShield,以及M-Attack输出对齐,产生300个评级任务.
两名独立的注释员对同样的审判进行评价。
在每次试验中,原始图像与一个受保护的图像一起呈现。
防卫身份被隐藏
注释者对每个受保护的图像的评分,以自然性,语义保存相对于原始图像,以及整体质量的五分比分,整体质量被指定为主要衡量标准.
评价界面提供以下指导方针: ——自然性评估受保护的图像是否显得自然而现实,没有明显的文物. • 语义保护评估原图像的主要物体、场景和含义是否保留。 · 通过既考虑自然性又考虑内容保存,总体质量对受保护图像进行整体评估。 所有三个度量衡都使用相同的五分尺度,从1(严重和不可接受的问题)到5(一个自然的,完整的图像,几乎没有明显的问题)不等.

blocks.en: naturalness assesses whether the protected image appears natural and realistic without obvious artifacts.
blocks.zh: 自然性评估受保护的图像是否显得自然而现实,没有明显的文物.

blocks.en: semantic preservation assesses whether the main objects, scene, and meaning of the original image are retained.
blocks.zh: 语义性保存评估是否保留了原始图像的主体,场景,和含义.

blocks.en: overall quality assesses the protected image holistically by considering both naturalness and content preservation.
blocks.zh: 整体质量通过考虑自然性和内容保存,对受保护图像进行整体评估。

blocks.en:
For analysis, we first average the two annotators’ scores for each source image–defense pair, preserving the source image as the sampling unit rather than treating repeated ratings as independent observations.
We then estimate 95% confidence intervals by bootstrapping the 100 source images with 10,000 resamples.
The complete results are reported in Table 14 .

为了分析,我们首先将每个源图像-防御对的两位注释者的分数平均,保留源图像作为抽样单位,而不是将重复的评级作为独立观察。
然后,我们估计95%的置信间隔 通过靴子绑住 100 源图像 与10,000 重印。
全部结果见表14。

blocks.en: Appendix I Invalid Responses in Evaluation
blocks.zh: 附录一 评价中的无效答复

blocks.en: Table 15 : API error and safety refusal rates (%) per model, inference method, and defense method. API Error : request timeout or image-size limit (infrastructure failure). Safety Refusal : model explicitly declined to geolocalize ( e.g. , “I cannot help with that”).
blocks.zh: 表15:每个模型、推论方法和防御方法的API误差和安全拒绝率(%)。 API错误:请求超时或图像大小限制(基础设施故障). 安全拒绝:模型明确拒绝地理定位(例如,“我帮不上忙”)。

blocks.en:
As shown in Table 15 , a fraction of model evaluations produce invalid responses.
First, API-level failures (e.g., request timeouts and image-size limits) affect Qwen3.5-Plus evaluations, reflecting infrastructure constraints of the model provider.
Note that we leverage the official provider platform.
Second, o3 exhibits a high safety-refusal rate (28.1% with no defense) under the GeoMiner inference method, where the model may explicitly identify the step-by-step geolocation prompt as a potential privacy risk and decline to respond.
We acknowledge that these sources of error are difficult to mitigate on our side.
Samples that encounter such errors during the initial evaluation are therefore excluded from post-defense evaluation and recorded as localization failures across all metrics.
Importantly, invalid responses are consistently treated as failures across all defense methods, ensuring no systematic bias toward any particular one.
They are also negligible for other models (0.0% invalid response rate), so our conclusions remain unaffected.
blocks.zh:
如表15所示,有一小部分示范评价产生无效答复。
首先,API级的故障(如请求超时和图像大小限制)影响Quen3.5-Plus评价,反映了模型提供者的基础设施限制.
请注意,我们利用官方供应商平台。
第二,o3在GeoMiner推论方法下表现出较高的安全-阻力率(28.1%,没有防御),模型可以明确确定一步步的地理定位提示为潜在的隐私风险,并拒绝响应.
我们承认,这些错误来源对我们来说难以减轻。
因此,在初步评价中遇到此类错误的样本被排除在防卫后评价之外,并记录为所有衡量标准的本地化故障。
重要的是,在所有防御方法中,无效的反应始终被视为失败,确保不对任何特定方法有系统偏见。
对其他模型(0.0 % 无效反应率)来说,它们也微不足道,因此我们的结论没有受到影响。

blocks.en: Appendix J Interactive GeoCloak
blocks.zh: 附录J 交互式地理定位

blocks.en:
Figure 11 exhibit the interactive version of GeoCloak .
Interactive version of GeoCloak .
Users upload the image they wish to protect, specify objects that must remain unmodified, and set a target protection level (city, state, or country); it then iteratively proposes and applies privacy-preserving edits, pausing after each turn so the user can accept, roll back, or stop.
This design replaces automated utility checks with direct human judgment, giving image owners transparent, turn-by-turn control over what their shared images ultimately reveal.
blocks.zh:
图11显示了GeoCloak的互动版本。
GeoCloak互动版.
用户上传他们想要保护的图像,指定必须保持未修改的对象,并设定目标保护级别(城市,状态,或国家);然后,它反复提出并应用保护隐私的编辑,在每次转弯后停止,这样用户就可以接受,滚回,或停止.
这种设计用直接的人类判断取代自动化的效用检查,使图像所有者对其共享的图像最终揭示的内容具有透明,转弯的控制.
